name: Muster Foam-Based Fire Suppression System
description: Automatic foam suppression system that protects mobile machinery from hydrocarbon fuel fires. On detection it discharges a large volume of foam that blankets the fuel surface, cools the hazard and prevents re-ignition.

name: Linear Heat Detection (LHD) System
description: Electrically controlled detection option for Muster foam systems. When fire is sensed the control panel enters fire mode, sounds an alarm, runs the shutdown sequence and triggers the cylinder valve to discharge foam, with manual activation available from the remote actuator.

name: Loss of Pressure (LOP) Detection System
description: Mechanical detection option built around a pressurised sensor tube. Fire ruptures the tube and the released inert gas trips the cylinder valve to discharge foam, and the valve can also be triggered manually with the remote actuator.

name: Lay Flat Cylinders
description: Compact lay flat foam cylinders designed for small machines with limited installation space.

name: Cylinder Valve
description: Machined from a single piece of billet stainless steel for reliability and performance.
specs: Configurations: electronic LHD or pneumatic LOP

name: Muster Impulse Powder System (IPS)
description: Self-generating, non-pressurised fire suppression system that converts dry chemical powder into a dense protective cloud on electrical activation, smothering flames and blanketing the risk area. Runs standalone or in a dual agent setup and suits mobile equipment in mining, construction, transportation, energy and marine service.
specs: System capacity: up to 8 IPS units via integration module
Detection: MusterWire in 68 C, 105 C and 180 C variants
Nozzle options: flat, cone, vector or straight

name: IPS Units
description: Self-generating, non-pressurised canisters that hold the dry chemical powder charge, available in four sizes. They mount directly inside the risk area or feed a pipe network fitted with discharge nozzles.
specs: Installation: direct mount or pipe network with nozzles

name: Muster Misting Fire Suppression System
description: Pre-engineered water-foam misting system that protects engine bays and fuel areas on mobile machinery. On detection it discharges a fine mist of fluorine-free F3 foam solution that absorbs heat, displaces oxygen and seals fuel vapours to prevent re-ignition.
specs: Detection: Loss of Pressure (LOP) automatic with manual actuation
Cylinder sizes: 15 L, 20 L and 23 L

name: Cylinders & Brackets
description: Stainless steel agent cylinders with lightweight mild steel mounting brackets, built to withstand vibration, shock and harsh conditions. Available in vertical or lay-flat configurations for tight installations.
specs: Cylinder capacities: 15 L, 20 L and 23 L

name: Indicator Panel
description: Panel that continuously monitors system integrity and actuation pressure, detects fire activation and raises audible and visual alerts. Configurable for Loss of Pressure or Agent Discharge confirmation modes.
specs: Monitoring: 24/7 via dual environmentally sealed pressure switches
Detection modes: Loss of Pressure confirmation or Agent Discharge confirmation

name: LOP Valve
description: Cylinder valve machined from a single piece of billet stainless steel for reliable discharge performance. Full 360 degree orientation allows the cylinder to be positioned for easy access, installation and servicing.

name: Misting Nozzles
description: Precision stainless steel nozzles that produce fine water-foam droplets, creating a dense mist that absorbs heat and suppresses flames in confined spaces with minimal water usage.

name: Fluorine Free (F3) Fire Suppression Concentrate
description: Fluorine-free foam concentrate that forms a vapour-sealing film over the fuel surface, cooling it and preventing re-ignition. Biodegradable, not bio-persistent, and effective on Class A and B fires.
specs: Mix ratio: 1 part concentrate to 99 parts water
Chemistry: fluorine free, no PFAS-based chemicals
Supply: pre-sized concentrate bottle included with each kit

name: Handheld Extinguishers
description: Range of handheld portable extinguishers covering fires in paper, textiles, wood, plastics, rubber, petrol, oil, paints, LPG, CNG, acetylene and electrically charged equipment. Available in ABE powder, carbon dioxide, foam, air/water and wet chemical types.
specs: Types: ABE Powder, Carbon Dioxide, Foam, Air/Water, Wet Chemical

name: Automatic & Mobile Extinguishers
description: Automatic extinguishers that activate at 79 degrees Celsius to protect unmanned fire risks, suitable for class A, B, C and E fires. Heavy duty trolley mounted options are available for mobile use.
specs: Types: ABE Powder, BE Powder, Carbon Dioxide, Foam
Fire classes: A, B, C, E

name: Fire Blankets
description: Made from woven fibreglass fire resistant fabric, certified to AS/NZS 3504. Supplied in a storage pouch with quick release tabs for easy mounting, backed by a one year warranty.
specs: Material: Woven fibreglass fire resistant fabric

name: Location & Identification Signage
description: Signage for quick identification of the correct extinguisher type, mounted above installed extinguishers. Helps locate equipment where direct line of sight is not possible.

name: Fire Extinguisher Brackets
description: Mounting brackets to suit multiple portable extinguishers, including strong quick release brackets for vehicles.

name: Portable Fire Equipment Accessories
description: Accessories that support the servicing and protection of portable extinguishers, from UV bags to security ties and service tags.

name: Muster Solid Aerosol Generator (SAG) System
description: Self-generating fire suppression system for enclosed spaces. A solid chemical compound, activated electrically or thermally, releases a fine aerosol that interrupts the chemical chain reaction in the flame, discharging directly from the unit with no cylinders, pipework or nozzles.
specs: Scalability: up to 8 SAG units per system via the integration module
Detection options: MusterWire rated 68 C, 105 C or 180 C

name: SAG Units
description: Self-generating aerosol canisters that hold the solid suppression compound and discharge directly from the unit. Supplied in a range of sizes and capacities to match different applications and protected volumes.

name: Control Panels
description: A family of control panels for the Muster foam fire suppression system, providing a complete solution for control, monitoring and activation.

name: Remote Actuators
description: Manual triggers that let the operator activate the suppression system at the first sign of a potential fire. Available in push-button or lever designs, made from stainless steel, and can sit near the protected enclosure or at a remote point.

name: Diagnostics Module
description: Add-on module that displays real time alarm panel parameters, system pressure, battery status and software update information. Technicians can access data logs through the Muster diagnostics utility app.
specs: Data access: Muster diagnostics utility app

name: Remote Activation Device
description: Remote trigger developed for autonomous vehicles, allowing crews to activate the fire suppression system from a distance when no operator is on board.

name: Signal Test Unit
